teaser: The recipe for a founder's own site: voice memos, an agent wired to GitHub that checks and publishes, GitHub Pages, and readers who pay a little.
core_idea: An authentic founder's brand is their story, and it needs a medium that keeps it; the loop this site runs on can be replicated with what exists today: a public GitHub repository published to GitHub Pages by a workflow that validates first, a Claude cloud session that reads a house-rules file, researches, checks, writes and pushes, voice memos as the input, and the reader meter from api.newsroom.sgit.ai with a Stripe Payment Link the founder owns; the writing pipeline is a pattern to copy, not yet a kit, and nothing confidential belongs in a public repository.

quotes.text: The memo is a draft of a thought; the article is the thought, checked.
It is an honesty box, not a paywall
Published GitHub Pages sites may be no larger than 1 GB

figures.caption: The loop: speak a memo; an agent session connected to one repository researches, writes and checks it; it commits and pushes; GitHub Actions validates and publishes to GitHub Pages; readers read, rate and top up through a payment link you own; and the record grows.

What you need, what it costs, and what is ready: a public GitHub repository, GitHub Pages published by GitHub Actions, a Claude plan with cloud sessions and the Claude GitHub App, a recorder that transcribes, house rules, the reader meter from api.newsroom.sgit.ai, a Stripe Payment Link; the writing pipeline as one package is not ready yet.
